messages:
violet_csm: Hey team — quick heads up on AtlasEdge onboarding. Customer reports p95 latency spikes around peak (approx 450ms) and their cost per 10k tokens is higher than expected. Renewal convo in ~3 weeks, want to reduce risk with a proactive perf play. Thinking: compact-model trial + route non-critical traffic to cheaper region + prefix cache warmup. @marta_cs any account-side concerns?

marta_cs: thanks, flagged. AtlasEdge is mid-enterprise, heavy RLHF completions for summaries. Renewal is health-conditional — if we can show stable latencies and a 20% cost win, good signal. They worry about accuracy regressions.

aj_dev: technically doable. Suggest a 2-step pilot: 1) run int8-quant compact model for background routes (tickets, summarization non-critical) 2) route critical auth/transaction routes to current model with failover. I can spin up a canary image of `redwood/compact-13b-int8-v1` and run A/B. Expected perf: ~30% token cost reduction, ~10-25% lower p95 in warm state.

sam_eng: +1. Propose a 24h canary with 10% traffic split. We'll enable prefix caching for repeated prefixes to reduce KV load. Example quick route config for canary: ```json
{"routes": [{"path": "/summaries","weight": 90, "model": "redwood/13b-v1"},{"path": "/summaries","weight": 10, "model": "redwood/compact-13b-int8-v1", "canary": true}], "fallback": "redwood/13b-v1", "cache_warmup": true}```

leo_sre: couple operational notes: 1) ensure latency SLOs measured per-route and alert on >20% p95 regression within 1h windows. 2) set automatic fallback if error rate >0.5% or hallucination score rises (we already have diff monitors). 3) plan regional routing: move low-cost batch traffic to eu-west while keeping auth in us-west.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: atlasedge-compact-pilot (10% traffic) — pods: 3 -> 6, region: eu-west. Logs streaming URL: https://deploys.internal/redwood/atlasedge-compact-pilot

violet_csm: customer concern: "we can't tolerate more wrong summaries" — can we commit to eval guardrails? I can run an enablement session to align acceptance criteria.

aj_dev: will generate a small prompt set (30 prompts) covering worst-case summaries and privacy-sensitive cases. We'll run automated quality checks (BLEU/ROUGE and our hallucination heuristics) before/after. Sample run: `./evals/run_eval --model compact-13b-int8-v1 --suite atlasedge_summaries.json` — results to shared drive.

marta_cs: I'll schedule the enablement call for Tue 10am PT with them and Product to review criteria. Also looping Legal for PII checklist.

sam_eng: operational plan: 24h canary, then 72h extended if metrics look good (latency down, cost down, hallucination delta < 1%). Fallback policy immediate on any threshold breach. I'll add a rollout note in the console and set an oncall watch for first 6 hours.

leo_sre: add tracing hooks for token-level latency and KV cache hit ratio so we can prove the mechanism of improvement. Also capture per-route cost delta.

violet_csm: perfect. I'll capture customer feedback after 24h and post summary here. Thanks all :thumbsup:

(reacts: :eyes: from aj_dev, :rocket: from sam_eng)
